question: Can a deeper congruence layer create another standard quadratic character after the derivative class already appears at level four?
method: Prove a uniform Frattini-quotient bound for every subgroup of GL2(Z/2^n) surjecting modulo two. Verify all 67 subspaces of M2(F2), the characteristic-two squaring identity, and small proper-image cocycle controls with early and delayed standard layers. Apply only the retained sixteen equation-only derivative exclusions and generic mod-two independence certificates.
failure_semantics: Finite controls alone do not prove the tower result. Application requires the written filtration argument and a nonzero level-four derivative class. boundary: Incidence-capacity theorem for the generic division tower, not a construction of the missing unramified block or a solubility/visibility feature. No active search changes.
